body:
**WINNIPEG**, **July 1, 2026** – The Winnipeg Jets Hockey Club announced today the team agreed to terms with forward Noah Gregor on a one-year, two-way contract with an average annual value in the NHL of $850,000.

Gregor, 27, recorded nine points (4G, 5A) and 26 penalty minutes in 37 games for the Florida Panthers in 2025-26. The Beaumont, Alta. native also had 17 points (11G, 6A) and four PIMs in 26 games for the AHL’s Charlotte Checkers last season, adding two goals in three playoff games for the Checkers. Gregor, originally drafted by the San Jose Sharks in the fourth round (111th overall) in the 2016 NHL Draft, has posted 79 points (40G, 39A) and 142 PIMs in 330 career games for four different NHL teams. He also featured in two postseason games for the Toronto Maple Leafs in 2024.

Internationally, Gregor has represented Canada on multiple occasions, including winning a silver medal at the 2022 World Championship where he had three points (2G, 1A) and four PIMs.
